text:
Somoza unveils the statue of Somoza in Somoza Stadium



        It is not that I believe the people raised this statue for me

        because I know better than you that I ordered it myself.

        Nor that I intend to pass with it into posterity

        because I know the people will tear it down one day.

        Nor that I wanted to raise for myself while alive

        the monument you will not raise for me when dead:

        rather I raised this statue because I know you hate it.

translation.title: 1. Here He Passed on Foot Through These Streets, Without Work or Position...
translation.editorial_note: The queued catalog title differs from the body; the translation preserves both the metadata title and the visible Somoza-stadium text.
